issues.description: Interface naming mismatch: the problem statement (UML and text) and the template Main.java refer to an interface named 'Milkable' with a method messageOnMilk(), but the solution repository provides that API under an interface named 'Dairy' (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Dairy.java) while the file src/de/tum/cit/ase/Milkable.java in the solution is empty. Additionally, solution classes Goat and Seal implement Dairy (Goat: implements Dairy at Goat.java:3; Seal: implements ... Dairy at Seal.java:4) instead of Milkable. This inconsistent naming (Milkable vs. Dairy) will confuse students about which interface to implement and can lead to compilation or integration problems when students follow the problem statement/template but compare or run against the provided solution artifacts.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the interface name consistent across all artifacts. Preferred fix: rename the solution's Dairy interface to Milkable (move messageOnMilk() into src/de/tum/cit/ase/Milkable.java or replace Dairy.java with Milkable.java), and update Goat.java and Seal.java to implement Milkable. Remove the empty Milkable.java file if present. Alternatively, if 'Dairy' is the intended name, update the problem statement and template examples to refer to 'Dairy' instead of 'Milkable'. Ensure the single chosen interface declares String messageOnMilk() so method signatures match the exercise description.
